comparison.objective: Lay out each room’s first floor tile from center lines so no border cut is less than half a tile.
comparison.physical_skill: Spatial planning, measurement, and initial tile placement.
comparison.success_condition: The first-tile layout yields border cuts of at least half a tile; room dimensions and tolerances are absent.
comparison.reason: The task tests layout reasoning and placement rather than contact-driven component finishing or loose-part containment.
